metadata.description: Distributed-systems, messaging, and integration patterns skill for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: distributed-systems-patterns
plugins.description: Apply distributed-systems, messaging, and integration patterns to architectural decisions, message contracts, and operational artifacts for event-driven, microservice, queue, broker, saga, outbox, CDC, workflow, scaling, resilience, and multi-region work. Default outputs are decisions and contracts, not implementation code; specific libraries are user choices. Includes 8 slash commands (/design, /review, /architecture, /contract, /runbook, /failure-mode, /readiness, /ship) and 27 reference files.
